scope: Complete analytical proofs of guarded actual-overlap compensation bounds. Unrestricted overlap and density remain open.
conventions: Finite strictly positive original probability law mu; symmetric nonnegative relative Markov root T; A=T^2, K_j=A^j; r>=l>=1,u>=1,h>=1. q_r=E_a T^u(e,a)K_r(a,c)K_u(a,d), H_r=E_e sqrt(q_r(e,c,d)q_r(e,x,d)), W_r=E_cxd K_h(c,x)K_l(c,d)H_r^2. Only output r varies in the fixed-u tail. All compositions and weights use original mu.

results.mixing_output_tail: If A is irreducible, 0<rho<1 is its largest nonconstant eigenvalue and J=mu_min^-1-1, then Jrho^r<=1/2 gives W_r-1>=rho^(r+u+l)-6J^2rho^(2r). Guard rho^r<=min(1/(2J),rho^(u+l)/(12J^2)) gives at least half the positive surplus for every h.
results.eventual_decrease: With u,l,h fixed, the stronger guard rho^r<=min(1/(2J),(1-rho)rho^(u+l)/(12J^2)) gives W_r-W_(r+1)>=half*(1-rho)rho^(r+u+l)>0. Not global monotonicity.
results.classes: For A-support components of mass p_C, actual T induces an equal-mass involution; feature processing is rectangular between tau^u(C) and C. Exact W=sum p_C^-1 W_C and limit sum p_C^-1. The class error is at most sum 6p_C^-1 J_C^2rho_C^(2r), under every J_Crho_C^r<=1/2. Multiple-class strictness has an explicit cutoff uniform in u,h and admissible l.
results.actual_feature_gain: Let C=J(1+J). Under Jrho^(3u/2)<=1/2 and 2Crho^(r+u/2)<=1/2, W_r-1>=rho^(r+u+l)-24C^2rho^(2r+u). Additional rho^(r-l)<=1/(48C^2) pays half the surplus, uniformly in h, allowing u to vary withr.

exact_checks: Original external KhKl law has total mass one; no posterior-law substitution.
Exact Gram-wedge defect, including m=T^(3u)=0 rows; square-root Lipschitz constant gives 6epsilon^2.
Complete positive pair/cubic spectral expansion; every stationary mode retained by class normalization.
Eventual-monotonicity sign uses nonnegative next loss, not an assumption that two decreasing quantities have ordered difference.
Rectangular class scalings q_C=p_C^2q, H=p_C^-1H_C, W=sum p_C^-1 W_C; no internal symmetric root assumed.
Actual centred identity q-m=R_(r+u)+E(T^u-1)K_u R_r; absolute root spectrum retains negative modes and half exponents.
All explicit mass/gap, positive-m and relative-error guards retained; one-state and rho=0 treated separately.
